JUDGMENT WAS REACHED BY STIPULATION. PLAINTIFF, CHARLES M. TRACEY SHALL HAVE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF 516 O'FARRELL STREET, #305, SAN FRANCISCO, 94102 AND RENT AND DAMAGES OF $1400. A WRIT OF POSSESSION SHALL ISSUE IMMEDIATELY BUT ACTUAL EVICTION SHALL BE STAYED UNTIL AFTER 9AM ON 11-15-94. THERE ISN'T ANY OTHER PERSON LIVING ON THE PREMISES OTHER THAN PHILIP ALLEN. THERE WILL NOT BE ANY OTHER STAYS OF EXECUTION. EACH PARTY SHALL BEAR HIS OWN ATTORNEYS FEES AND COSTS. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT SHALL WAIVE ALL CLAIMS AGAINST EACH OTHER INCLUDING THOSE COVERED UNDER 1542 OF THE CALIFORNIA CIVIL CODE. IF THE DEFENDANT, PHILIP ALLEN VACATES 516 O'FARRELL STREET, #305, SAN FRANCISCO, BY 9AM, 11-15-94 AND TURNS OVER THE KEYS TO PLAINTIFF, CHARLES M. TRACEY, THE JUDGMENT SHALL BE DEEMED SATISFIED IN FULL.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ALLEN, PHILIP THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 516 O'FARRELL STREET, #305, SAN FRANCISCO, CA 94102 $1,400.00 RENT, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,400.00, STAYED UNTIL NOV-15-1994, LEASE FORFEITED
